title: Enbridge Mainline: Configuration Schematic and Print Sheet
dek: This is a configuration schematic, not a map: twenty lines in configuration order from Edmonton to Sarnia, with the Chicago, Cushing and Ontario branches drawn where they actually connect. The system is one uncommitted pool under the Mainline Tolling Settlement (to December 31, 2028): apportionment binds per line and key point, never system-wide, and the filed tolls below are the durable numbers the configuration runs on.
